'''Tomada''' was an [[Ogier]] from the [[Age of Legends]].

==History==
Tomada was among the Ogier that sang with [[Someshta]], [[Coumin]], and the [[Da'shain Aiel]]. After the singing, he asks a soldier for news about the [[War of Power|war]]. The soldier replies that [[Lews Therin Telamon]] and the [[Hundred Companions]] succeeded in sealing the [[Bore]].{{ref/book|4|26}}
